newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait denies Kuwaitis arrest over Saudi bombing.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait denies Kuwaitis arrest over Saudi bombing.

text.p: Kuwait denied on Monday reports that two Kuwaitis had been arrested in Saudi Arabia in connection with a bombing in June which killed 19 Americans.
The Interior Ministry said in a brief statement that contacts were held with Saudi Arabia which "affirmed that Kuwaitis were not arrested in that respect".

Kuwaiti media carried reports by news agencies on the arrest of three Saudis, two Kuwaitis and a Lebanese in connection with the bombing of a residential military complex in eastern Saudi Arabia in June.
